create.name: Sonic Yogi
create.bio:
Sonic Yogi is the working name of Jonathan Adams, a classically trained musician based in Atlanta, Georgia, who turned to singing bowls and simple tones during a difficult personal period and found that they helped him settle. He began recording these sounds and giving them away online, and over the following decade the tracks have been played many millions of times on YouTube, streaming services and meditation apps. Alongside Tibetan and crystal bowls he plays fretless guitar, Native American flute and gong, often drawing on the mood of Indian ragas.

His teaching centres on how rhythm, frequency and breath can lead the mind into stillness and deeper meditation. He has spoken about sound and meditation at TEDx and at the MindBody conference, and in the Atlanta area he leads live sound meditations, plays for yoga classes and offers one-to-one sound sessions. On YouTube he mixes long sound journeys with short explainers on instruments, entrainment and setting up audio for sound work, and on his own site a pay-what-you-want membership opens up guided meditations, rhythmic breathing practices, talks and two audio courses.

courses.title: Sonic Yogi Membership
courses.description: A monthly membership on his own site with tiers set by the listener. The top tier unlocks his guided and instrumental meditations, rhythmic breathing practices, timed tracks, talks and two audio courses, with streaming and downloads.
courses.price: Pay what you want, from $5 USD a month (free listening tier by donation)

free_resources.title: Sonic Yogi on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A large library of singing bowl, flute and guitar soundscapes, chakra-themed bowl sessions and breath-led sound meditations. Free to listen to in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Binaural Beat Generator
free_resources.description: A simple browser tool on his site that plays a binaural beat. You choose the carrier tone and the beat frequency, then listen on headphones as a focus for meditation.

free_resources.title: About Sound Therapy
free_resources.description: A free article in which he sets out his understanding of sound work: its roots in sacred music, how rhythm and frequency relate to brainwaves, and how it differs from music therapy.

flags: Listed under his stage name Sonic Yogi (as on Insight Timer, YouTube and his site); the person behind it is Jonathan Adams, named on his press kit, Instagram and in a 2017 VoyageATL interview. A human may prefer 'Jonathan Adams' as the listing name.

Much of his output is instrumental music (singing bowl, flute and guitar albums sold on Bandcamp and streaming); I kept only talks, explainers and guided or breath-led sessions as videos, but he sits between musician and teacher.

Website is a band-site template (Bandzoogle) with a footer dated 2017–2022 and no upcoming live dates; YouTube shows uploads through 2026 (Atlanta Center for Wellness, Oct 2025). In-person base is from his Atlanta sound meditations, yoga-class work and one-to-one sessions mentioned in the VoyageATL interview and Meetup group; no current sessions page with prices, so sessions are not listed as an offering.
His own story starts with severe anxiety and his site and Meetup copy talk about nervous-system reset and anxiety relief; none of that is used, and the bio refers only to a difficult personal period.

Kept the Insight Timer course 'Heal Through The Power Of Sound & Frequency': the title says 'heal' but names no condition and the lessons are about frequency and meditation. Borderline; a human may want to drop it.

Photos are stage shots from the MindBody conference in his site's press-kit gallery; all show the same man, matching the Sonic Yogi guitar-and-flute performance shots, but none is captioned with his name.
Only the first sentence of his Insight Timer bio could be saved via WebFetch; the bio check relied mainly on his site pages and press kit.
left_out: Insight Timer course 'Release Stress Through Sound & Frequency' (stress and trauma framing).
Sleep, 'nervous system reset' and 'deep sleep' YouTube videos; chakra singing bowl pieces, shamanic drumming and other music-only videos.
Album downloads and singles (music, not teaching).
Meetup 'Release Stress with Sonic Relaxation' events (stress framing, listings look auto-repeated and marked online only).
PDF downloads page (members only, could not be checked).
